title: Microsoft Purview: send Microsoft Foundry prompts and responses to Purview per Azure subscription
notes: claim 35: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: some passages incorrectly exclude calls that explicitly supply user context from policy coverage unless they authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID. The cost discussion also implies that Foundry audit records incur consumption charges, although Microsoft explicitly includes Foundry applications in Audit Standard.
